name: [UPD 2.4] Slugterra Battle Arena
desc:
Slug it OUT!

The epic world of Slugterra is now officially on Roblox! 
Gather your friends and put your slugslinger skills to the test in Slugterra Battle Arenas.

NEW GHOUL - NEW GHOUL - AQUAFREAK has arrived! 🌚When shot, this ghoul unleashes a high-pressure stream of water that damages enemies and push them back.

Like us and get 500 coins 🪙bonus!

🐣 Find & collect the cute Sluglings pets!
🔫 Arena Duels - Challenge other players in 1v1, 2v2, and 3v3 duels using Slugs with unique abilities.
🌳Explore Diverse Environments - Venture through unique landscapes and discover hidden Slugs to build a powerful arsenal.
🎯Combat Creatures and Bosses - Defeat enemies to earn XP and level up your Slugs, enhancing their abilities.
🎁Unlock Weapon Skins  - Customize your gear with different weapon skins.
🪙Find Hidden Treasures - Search for hidden treasures for valuable rewards.

Join our group and social platform for exclusive content and news!
